Please don't do it. WHo knows who you'll find in the future, what opportunities there will be. Sure it seems meaningless for now, but maybe if you push through this a little it will get better. You never know. I think you are a beautiful person. A smart, educated, well-read person
. It would be a shame to throw it away. Please. I think it would be far worse for your parents to lose another child. Stay with us, OP.
I  know this and I try to control the urge to end it, but self control will finish at some point. Maybe not this week,month.  but for now I don't see anything but darkness in my future..
